1.explanation:
• packages/grid/scss/_settings.scss, _grid.scss and carbon-grid.scss: These SCSS sources drive the margin and container rules for each breakpoint in the standalone @carbon/grid package. The ‘max’ breakpoint margin value is still hard-coded at 16px here and must be bumped to 24px.  
• packages/components/src/globals/js/settings.js: This JS settings file exports the same breakpoint definitions (including margins) for use in JavaScript-driven layouts. It currently defines ‘max’ with a 1rem (16px) margin and needs to be updated to 1.5rem (24px).  
• packages/components/src/globals/grid/__tests__/grid-test.js & its snapshot: These unit tests assert the grid settings object, including the ‘max’ breakpoint margin. Once the margin value is updated, both the test and its stored snapshot must be updated to expect 24px instead of 16px.
1.bug_scenario: In both the Sketch spec and the Carbon docs the “max” breakpoint (≥1584px) uses a 24px outer margin, but the live grid preview and our code still shrink that margin down to 16px (1rem). The two screenshots show exactly that: the grey “max-1584px-16 column” gutter on the left remains at 16px even though the docs prescribe 24px.

2.explanation:
• packages/grid/scss/_settings.scss and _breakpoints.scss define the Sass variables and mixins that set breakpoint‐specific margins in the published @carbon/grid package; that’s where the 16px default for the max breakpoint lives in CSS.
• packages/components/src/globals/grid/index.js is the JavaScript representation of those same breakpoint and margin values (used internally by the site demos), so it also hard‐codes the 16px for max.
• packages/components/src/components/grid/grid.config.js drives the live preview on the Carbon site and similarly inherits the wrong max-breakpoint margin.
• The test in packages/components/src/globals/grid/__tests__/grid-test.js (and its snapshot) asserts on the current grid settings; it will need to be updated to expect 24px at the max breakpoint once the defaults are corrected.
2.bug_scenario: When you view the grid at the maximum breakpoint in code (≥1584px), both sides are being given a 16px margin (“16 column”), but according to the Carbon docs and Sketch mockups the outer margin at that breakpoint should be 24px. In other words, the code’s max-breakpoint margin is still 16px, despite the documentation calling for 24px.
